name: Pop and rock
description: Pop and rock songs and songwriters.
curatedFacts: "Bohemian Rhapsody" has no chorus: it moves through an intro, a ballad, an opera section, hard rock and a coda.
The opera section of "Bohemian Rhapsody" needed about 180 vocal overdubs.
"Piano Man" retells Billy Joel's six months as a lounge pianist at a Los Angeles bar in 1972–73.
Bernie Taupin writes Elton John's lyrics on his own; Elton then sets them to music.
Elton John and Bernie Taupin were paired in 1967 after both answered the same record-label advert.
John Lennon finished writing "Imagine" on a Steinway piano in a bedroom at his home in 1971.
Paul McCartney wrote "Let It Be" after dreaming of his late mother, Mary.
